svg.aria-label: The corpus as a treemap where area is case count. Groups by attacked surface: What the agent sends 72 cases, What comes back 18 cases, Tools and their supply chain 70 cases, Peer agent traffic 22 cases, Long-lived connections 11 cases, Getting past the scanner 30 cases, High-value payloads 11 cases, Must not be blocked 22 cases. The benign control group is outlined because it is scored on the false-positive axis.
